bw11-104.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

bw11-RC5.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

attacks.name: Charm

attacks.name: Thundershock

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze

bw11-RC8.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
